scripts.set:prod: bash -c 'set -a; . ./.env.compose; set +a; unset COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME COMPOSE_FILE; exec bash -i'
scripts.docker:restart:php: docker compose restart symfony-cli symfony-web catalog-cli catalog-web catalog-grpc cart-cli cart-web
scripts.docker:cache:clear:php: docker compose exec symfony-cli php -d memory_limit=1G bin/console cache:clear && docker compose exec catalog-cli php -d memory_limit=1G bin/console cache:clear && docker compose exec cart-cli php -d memory_limit=1G bin/console cache:clear && npm run docker:restart:php
scripts.catalog:elasticsearch:reindex: docker compose exec -e PRODUCT_SEARCH_BATCH_SIZE=${PRODUCT_SEARCH_BATCH_SIZE:-100} catalog-cli php -d memory_limit=${PRODUCT_SEARCH_REINDEX_MEMORY_LIMIT:-512M} bin/console --env=prod --no-debug app:elasticsearch:reindex
scripts.vendors:install: docker compose run --rm symfony-cli composer install && docker compose run --rm catalog-cli composer install && docker compose run --rm cart-cli composer install
scripts.vendors:install:prod: docker compose run --rm symfony-cli composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && docker compose run --rm catalog-cli composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && docker compose run --rm cart-cli composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction
scripts.minio:bucket:create: docker compose run --rm minio-client mb --ignore-existing local/app
scripts.minio:bucket:ls: docker compose run --rm minio-client ls local/app
scripts.minio:ls: docker compose run --rm minio-client ls local
